mapper.select: select list_version from product_catalog_state where id = 1
select list_version from product_catalog_state where id = 1 for update
mapper.update: update product_catalog_state set list_version = list_version + 1, updated_at = current_timestamp(3) where id = 1 and list_version = #{expectedVersion} and list_version < 9007199254740991
mapper.insert: insert into product_catalog_revision(product_id, item_version, item_state, updated_at) values(#{productId}, #{itemVersion}, #{itemState}, current_timestamp(3)) on duplicate key update item_version = values(item_version), item_state = values(item_state), updated_at = values(updated_at)

insert into product_projection_task( target, product_id, catalog_version, operation, payload, payload_sha256, status, attempt_count, claim_count, repair_count, next_retry_at, created_at, updated_at ) values ( #{target}, #{productId}, #{catalogVersion}, #{operation}, #{payload}, #{payloadSha256}, #{status}, #{attemptCount}, #{claimCount}, #{repairCount}, #{nextRetryAt}, current_timestamp(3), current_timestamp(3) )

insert into product_projection_task( target, product_id, catalog_version, operation, payload, payload_sha256, status, attempt_count, claim_count, repair_count, next_retry_at, created_at, updated_at ) values ( #{target}, #{productId}, #{catalogVersion}, #{operation}, #{payload}, #{payloadSha256}, #{status}, #{attemptCount}, #{claimCount}, #{repairCount}, #{nextRetryAt}, current_timestamp(3), current_timestamp(3) ) on duplicate key update id=id
mapper.select: select product_id,item_version,item_state,es_locked_by,es_locked_until,updated_at from product_catalog_revision where product_id=#{productId} for update
mapper.update: update product_projection_task set status='FAILED_TERMINAL', locked_by=null, locked_until=null, next_retry_at=null, last_error_summary='attempt_budget_exhausted_after_lease_recovery', completed_at=current_timestamp(3), updated_at=current_timestamp(3) where target=#{target} and attempt_count >= #{maxAttempts} and (status in ('PENDING','RETRY_WAIT') or (status='PROCESSING' and locked_until<current_timestamp(3)))
mapper.select: select * from product_projection_task where target=#{target} and attempt_count < #{maxAttempts} and ((status='PENDING') or (status='RETRY_WAIT' and (next_retry_at is null or next_retry_at<=current_timestamp(3))) or (status='PROCESSING' and locked_until<current_timestamp(3))) order by catalog_version asc,id asc limit 1 for update skip locked
mapper.update: update product_catalog_revision set es_locked_by=#{token},es_locked_until=#{lockedUntil},updated_at=current_timestamp(3) where product_id=#{productId} and (es_locked_until is null or es_locked_until<current_timestamp(3) or es_locked_by=#{token})

update product_projection_task set status='PROCESSING', attempt_count=attempt_count+1, claim_count=claim_count+1, locked_by=#{token}, locked_until=#{lockedUntil}, next_retry_at=null, updated_at=current_timestamp(3) where id=#{id} and attempt_count<#{maxAttempts} and (status in ('PENDING','RETRY_WAIT') or (status='PROCESSING' and locked_until<current_timestamp(3)))
mapper.select: select count(*) from product_projection_task t join product_catalog_revision r on r.product_id=t.product_id where t.id=#{id} and t.status='PROCESSING' and t.locked_by=#{token} and t.locked_until>#{requiredUntil} and r.item_version=t.catalog_version and (t.target<>'ES' or (r.es_locked_by=#{token} and r.es_locked_until>#{requiredUntil}))
mapper.update: update product_projection_task set status=#{status}, next_retry_at=#{nextRetryAt}, last_error_summary=#{lastErrorSummary}, locked_by=null, locked_until=null, completed_at=case when #{status} in ('SUCCEEDED','SUPERSEDED','FAILED_TERMINAL') then current_timestamp(3) else null end, updated_at=current_timestamp(3) where id=#{id} and status='PROCESSING' and locked_by=#{token}
mapper.select: select * from product_projection_reconcile_run where active_slot=1 order by id desc limit 1
select * from product_projection_reconcile_run order by id desc limit 1

select t.id,t.target,r.product_id,r.item_version catalog_version, coalesce(t.operation,case when r.item_state='ACTIVE' then 'UPSERT' else 'DELETE' end) operation, t.payload,t.payload_sha256,t.status,t.attempt_count,t.claim_count,t.repair_count, t.next_retry_at,t.locked_by,t.locked_until,t.last_error_summary,t.created_at,t.updated_at, t.completed_at,t.manual_replay_count,t.last_replayed_at from product_catalog_revision r left join product_projection_task t on t.target='ES' and t.product_id=r.product_id and t.catalog_version=r.item_version where r.product_id>#{afterProductId} order by r.product_id asc limit #{limit}
select t.* from product_catalog_revision r join product_projection_task t on t.target='ES' and t.product_id=r.product_id and t.catalog_version=r.item_version where r.product_id=#{productId}
mapper.update: update product_projection_task set status='RETRY_WAIT',attempt_count=0,next_retry_at=current_timestamp(3), repair_count=repair_count+1,locked_by=null,locked_until=null, completed_at=null,last_error_summary='reconciliation_drift',updated_at=current_timestamp(3) where id=#{id} and status in ('SUCCEEDED','SUPERSEDED') and repair_count<#{maxRepairs}

update product_projection_reconcile_run set status='FAILED_TERMINAL',locked_by=null,locked_until=null,next_retry_at=null, last_error_summary='reconciliation_attempt_budget_exhausted', completed_at=current_timestamp(3),updated_at=current_timestamp(3) where active_slot=1 and attempt_count>=#{maxAttempts} and (status in ('PENDING','RETRY_WAIT') or (status='RUNNING' and locked_until<current_timestamp(3)))

update product_projection_reconcile_run set attempt_count=attempt_count + case when status='RUNNING' and locked_until<current_timestamp(3) then 1 else 0 end, status='RUNNING',locked_by=#{token},locked_until=#{lockedUntil},next_retry_at=null, started_at=coalesce(started_at,current_timestamp(3)),updated_at=current_timestamp(3) where active_slot=1 and attempt_count<#{maxAttempts} and (status='PENDING' or (status='RETRY_WAIT' and (next_retry_at is null or next_retry_at<=current_timestamp(3))) or (status='RUNNING' and locked_until<current_timestamp(3))) order by id asc limit 1
mapper.select: select * from product_projection_reconcile_run where status='RUNNING' and locked_by=#{token} limit 1
mapper.update: update product_projection_reconcile_run set phase=#{phase},status=#{status},cursor_payload=#{cursorPayload}, scan_count=#{scanCount},drift_count=#{driftCount},repair_count=#{repairCount}, clean_verify_count=#{cleanVerifyCount},last_error_summary=#{lastErrorSummary}, locked_by=null,locked_until=null, completed_at=case when #{status} in ('SUCCEEDED','FAILED_TERMINAL') then current_timestamp(3) else null end, updated_at=current_timestamp(3) where id=#{id} and status='RUNNING' and locked_by=#{lockedBy}

update product_projection_reconcile_run set status=#{status},attempt_count=attempt_count+1,next_retry_at=#{nextRetryAt}, last_error_summary=#{lastErrorSummary},locked_by=null,locked_until=null, completed_at=case when #{status}='FAILED_TERMINAL' then current_timestamp(3) else null end, updated_at=current_timestamp(3) where id=#{id} and status='RUNNING' and locked_by=#{token}
mapper.select: select summary.target,summary.status,summary.task_count,summary.oldest_created_at, summary.max_attempts,summary.total_attempts,summary.next_retry_at, (select recent.last_error_summary from product_projection_task recent where recent.target=summary.target and recent.status=summary.status and recent.last_error_summary is not null order by recent.updated_at desc,recent.id desc limit 1) last_error_summary from ( select target,status,count(*) task_count,min(created_at) oldest_created_at, max(attempt_count) max_attempts,sum(attempt_count) total_attempts, min(next_retry_at) next_retry_at from product_projection_task group by target,status ) summary order by summary.target,summary.status

select id,target,product_id,catalog_version,operation,status,attempt_count,claim_count, repair_count,manual_replay_count,next_retry_at,locked_until,last_error_summary, created_at,updated_at,completed_at,last_replayed_at from product_projection_task where (#{target} is null or target=#{target}) and (#{status} is null or status=#{status}) order by id desc limit #{limit}
mapper.update: update product_projection_task set status='RETRY_WAIT',attempt_count=0,next_retry_at=current_timestamp(3), locked_by=null,locked_until=null,completed_at=null, manual_replay_count=manual_replay_count+1,last_replayed_at=current_timestamp(3), last_error_summary='manual_replay',updated_at=current_timestamp(3) where id=#{id} and status='FAILED_TERMINAL' and locked_by is null
